verdict.rationale: Sentry's own docs say sentry-cli is primarily used for source maps management and can upload release artifacts, and it has a dedicated 'Uploading Source Maps' page for JavaScript, so CLI-based source map upload is a documented first-party capability. However, much of that evidence is just a page title or a one-line summary. Missing for 10: any evidence of a bundler plugin (webpack/Vite etc.), explicit CI workflow documentation, detail showing that production stack traces resolve to original source, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
